Morning Rob. I can't pull up the live status on your orders right now, so here's where things stood last time we spoke.

To send the KBOX, use the prepaid UPS label we emailed on November 11 (tracking ····). The address is already on it: ShipBob Returns, (address hidden), Chattanooga, TN (postal code hidden). Write Shop···· on the box.

Your two Thor P2s were on their way to you. Keep that box sealed when it arrives. The team still has your request for a second 40T and will answer by email.

Rob, I've got your orders up now. Your return is open and the label is still good. We haven't received the KBOX yet, so go ahead and send it.

Put the KBOX in a box, write Shop···· on the outside, and drop it at UPS with the prepaid label from November 11 (tracking ····). It goes to our Chattanooga, TN warehouse.
